I am 63 years old and I have farmed this small piece of land since I was young. This plot is only a tiny corner, 0.08 hectare, and I will not buy chemical fertilizer because one bag is too big and too costly for such a small place. I will put goat manure on it instead, and I will plant with my own seed that I kept from last year. I will work this plot myself with my family for about 12 days this season, and I will not hire anyone or buy any chemicals because there is no money for that on such a small plot.
